column2: Builds a page whose buttons wake a bot over a webhook. Out because the webhook is a Cursor Automations routine, which has no counterpart here
The catch-up of ketchup as a short subtitled video. Out because no renderer is installed and no session asked for one

Checks a TLA+ model of a flow and draws it as a Mermaid statechart, with the shortest path to each state that breaks a rule. Out because TLC and Java are not installed, and another tool may take its place
Generates a project skill that proves a property with a model checker, a proof, or another verifier. Out with statechart, which reads its TLA+ results
Brings a generated formal verification back in line after the code it covers changed. Out with the skill that generates one

How to sort the comments of Bugbot, Cursor's review bot, with patterns learned on Cursor's code. Out because no repository here has a review bot: the reviews on the user's pull requests come from people
Checks each UI component against a baseline image until the pixel diff is zero. Out because it needs a control skill to drive the UI, and the work here seldom has a UI
